style: Cinematic, natural motion, 35mm film look, no on-screen text.

shots.prompt: Very slow dolly in toward the person. They stand completely still with eyes closed, breathing gently. Camera movement only, silent.
The person slowly opens their eyes, then tilts their head back and looks up toward the ceiling, as if reading words written in the air above them. Static camera.
The person nods helpfully with a small warm smile and opens one hand in a welcoming gesture. Static camera.
The lobster sways to a funky beat and sings into the tiny microphone, claws bobbing in rhythm. Slight handheld push in.
The person sings with confidence, chin raised, wind moving the coat and the sails behind. Static camera.
The person sings, monitor glow flickering across their face. Static camera.
The person nods gently while singing, pen resting on the notepad. Static camera.

The room and the costume dissolve away in layers like peeling paint: the armchair and bookshelves fade to white, the cardigan falls away, until the same person stands alone in a plain seamless white room wearing a grey t-shirt. Slow, dreamlike, continuous.

Faint pale blue light flickers softly across the blank wall like distant projected text that never resolves. The person sits still, then slowly lowers their head. Very slow push in. Quiet and melancholy.
The lobster belts out a big note with both claws raised high, then pumps a claw to the beat. Energetic, joyful.
